name: Currency Conversion Response 3 Code
definition: Result of a requested currency conversion.

ODCC.name: Allowed
ODCC.definition: Dynamic currency conversion may be offered to the cardholder.

DCCA.name: Assumed
DCCA.definition: Transaction authorised with dynamic currency conversion.

ICRD.name: Invalid Card
ICRD.definition: The card is not valid for dynamic currency conversion.

IMER.name: Invalid Merchant
IMER.definition: The card acceptor has not been recognised.

IPRD.name: Invalid Product
IPRD.definition: Dynamic currency conversion service cannot be offered for this card product.

NDCC.name: Not Available
NDCC.definition: Dynamic currency conversion is not available for other reason.

REST.name: Restriction
REST.definition: Conversion accepted for the requested amount exclusively.

CATG.name: Catalogue
CATG.definition: Conversion accepted for a range of amounts.
